title: Stable $q$-Hermitian coordinate calculus: Capelli--PBW transport, mixed polarization algebra, and localization obstructions
summary: We extend a finite-support $q$-Hermitian radial calculus to Clifford-valued coordinate polynomials. For $N$ bosonic Hermitian vector labels and finite fermionic support, the stable range $m\ge 2N$ admits a canonical Gram--harmonic normal form by Howe separation. A label--Capelli inverse normalizes the Clifford contractions, while a finite Wick--Chevalley conjugation lifts the divided-power scalar gauge to the full Clifford PBW module.
